subject.title: [Bug]: Sandbox prune does not clean up workspace directory

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open conflicting fork fix for this focused prune-workspace cleanup, or fold this behavior into the broader managed sandbox lifecycle issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but deleting sandbox workspace state is an ownership-sensitive cleanup and there is already an open conflicting fork PR plus a broader maintainer-authored lifecycle issue.

options.title: Land a narrow prune cleanup
options.body: Adopt or replace the linked fork with a focused fix that removes only eligible non-shared local sandbox workspaces after successful runtime removal and adds regression tests.

options.title: Fold into lifecycle work
options.body: Keep this issue open as supporting context and let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98516 define the permanent cleanup policy before changing prune behavior.

options.title: Close or supersede the fork first
options.body: Resolve the conflicting fork PR so there is one canonical implementation path before allowing a new repair attempt.

recommendation.title: Land a narrow prune cleanup
recommendation.body: Adopt or replace the linked fork with a focused fix that removes only eligible non-shared local sandbox workspaces after successful runtime removal and adds regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on sandbox lifecycle and owns the broader related lifecycle discussion.
